mentions.name: MapBooksCRM
mentions.description: Offline, OSM-first map-based CRM that plots customers on a map and combines CRM and accounting to track customer details and payments within a defined area, along with stats showing monthly and yearly performance. The data layer is abstracted from the app to avoid lock-in, and it is planned for sale as one-time licensed software.
mentions.audience: Businesses that need to track customer details and payments within a defined area; originally built for an HoA.
mentions.source_excerpt: MapBooksCRM (https://www.codenius.com/products/map-crm/) - A very unique app that uses maps to map out your customers (OSM-first). I built it for an HoA, but it can be used for any type of business that requires the ability to track customer details/payments within a defined area. It is equal parts CRM/Accounting software that also provides useful stats to see how your monthly/yearly performance is. Same like Vantabill, this app is completely offline and the data layer is abstracted from the app (no lock-in). I'm hoping to sell this software as 1-time licensed software (pre-SaaS style) and I'd love to give you a demo.
